The derivative of the natural logarithm is the reciprocal function:

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(ln⁡x)=\frac{1}{x}
$$

We apply our formula and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\frac{11}{4}ln⁡x) \\  & =\frac{11}{4}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(ln⁡x) \\  & =\frac{11}{4}\cdot \frac{1}{x} \\  & =\frac{11}{4x}.\end{aligned}
$$
